nom: TULA Detox in a Jar Exfoliating Treatment Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report reduced excess sebum, smaller-looking pores, and a balancing effect, with one noting it must not be left on past 5 minutes or it can hurt the skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or acne-prone dry skin say the mask does not dry out or strip their skin and leaves it soft, though a few unspecified users mention a temporary white cast/waxy film that requires rewashing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report fewer breakouts, less flaking/oiliness when routine is skipped, and smoother, more balanced skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it doesn't irritate and even reduces redness and reactivity, but multiple others report burning, stinging that outlasts rinsing, or an inability to leave it on the full time.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing an 'average amount of oily skin' as reference reports thorough pore cleaning without a stripped feeling.
segments.mature: One 37-year-old reviewer reports her skin looked more youthful with reduced redness and mild breakouts after use.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports a more youthful look and one reviewer notes fine lines and pores appearing less visible with use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the mask does not dry out skin and even feels hydrating; a couple caution it should be limited to once or twice weekly or it makes skin too dry.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including sensitive-skin users, report calmer, less red skin after use, with one noting reduced redness even amid retinoid-related complications; no reviewer reports increased redness from the mask itself, though burning sensations are common during use.
concerns.barrier: One licensed esthetician reports the mask clogged pores and left her needing to 'repair' her skin barrier; no other reviewer raises barrier concerns.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced blackheads, cleared pores, and smaller-looking pores over time, including one noting blackheads gone and staying away after two weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including those with cystic, hormonal, and adult acne, report fewer or shorter-lived breakouts and cleared existing blemishes; one reviewer nonetheless found little exfoliation benefit and one esthetician reports it clogged her t-zone and caused visible impaction.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the mask balances and reduces excess sebum and oily shine throughout the day, with one saying foundation lasted longer afterward.

aspects.libelle: White cast or waxy residue after rinsing
Product goes a long way for the price

extraits.titre: Wish I could do zero stars
extraits.texte: As a licensed estie, I was always skeptical about this product, but one of my cliente swears by it. I finally tried it, & it was terrible. It clogged my pores in all of my t-zone. Washed if off, & lightly exfoliated with it (like directions say) & you could see little blue dots all over my face. Completely in my pores. I had to exfoliate MORE & use an extractor to get some out. Here is to reparing my skin barrier because of this product !!! Definitely not "detox in a jar"

I'm sure this is a wonderful product for most but for those that have super sensitive skin, Do Not Try!!! This burns really bad and usually I'll deal with the burn but this one I couldn't even last 10 seconds of rubbing it on. My skin burned for awhile after washing it off as well. No go for sensitive skin!!!

i have sensitive, combo, acne prone skin. aka my skin is impossible. i'm always very hesitant to try new products but am going through purging at the moment and felt my skin needed a little boost so i decided to try this out. WOW. this didn't break me out, and left my skin feeling so balanced. face masks geared toward acne usually make my skin feel so dry but this stuff is unreal. i feel like it really helped clear my purging gunk out of the way. highly highly recommend.

I have very dry, acne prone skin. This mask is everything that I hopped it would be. It does not dry out my skin. It brightens my face because it cleanses it so well. And my acne doesn't last as long! My skin is sooooooo soft it seriously is amazing. 100% would recommend!

I have very sensitive skin with redness, large pores, and blackheads. Lately have had some complications due to retinoids and other treatments. I needed a gentle but effective way to exfoliate and this went above and beyond. My skin was brighter after just one use. With continued use over the next two weeks, I saw a dramatic improvement in pore size and the blackheads are gone and staying away. It literally looks like I have a primer on when I look in the mirror, but all I have on is lotion. It's because the mask has been working so well. And I feel like my skin is brighter and also less red. Lactic acid is a great chemical exfoliant for sensitive skin. The corn meal in this also provides a gentle physical exfoliant because it doesn't have the sharp edges of other physical exfoliators that can leave micro tears in the skin. Bentonite Clay does such a great job at sucking all of the gunk out. I make some of my own skin care products and normally I would complain about the cost of this but for me it has been worth every penny. Would give this more stars if I could and will continue to repurchase.

extraits.titre: Changed my skin after one use
extraits.texte: Been battling COVID skin for the last several months- change in texture and breakouts like never before. And the ironic thing, I've been following my skin routine to the T! Until about 1.5-2 months of complete skincare change to Tula and this wonderful mask. Used the mask for the first time and wow my skin felt and looked so youthful (37yo with redness & mild breakouts.) It was like a dose of everything my skin needed combined with Tula's night/day cream and eye cream. Perfection.

I have oily acne prone skin. Also in my late 20's and I'm a mom. So nice stressed out skin as well. I put this on whenever I notice my skin to start getting worse. Just pay attention to the time frame of 5 minutes and don't let it stay on longer, because it can actually hurt your skin. Received this as a sample and loved it so much, broke down and bought the full size. Definitely worth the money.
